name: Cream Lemon - Star Trap
original_name: くりぃむレモン スタートラップ
source:
This visual novel faithfully follows the story of Star Trap, the 10th episode of the adult OVA (Original Video Animation) series Cream Lemon while featuring some additional scenes.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1986.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
本作忠实再现了成人OVA系列《奶油柠檬》第10集《星之陷阱》的故事，同时加入了若干新场景。

[改编自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1986.html]vndbreview[/url]]
